Subject: Acme MAP: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan

Hi Ava and Samir -

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have shared alignment and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I've missed or dates that don't work.

Key pains and goals we heard
- High per-inference cost on current vendor, rising token volumes are making costs unpredictable.
- Latency SLA concerns for user-facing features (target p95 < 200ms).
- Need enterprise controls: VPC, audit logs, and SSO integration for compliance.
- Primary success criteria: reduce per-transaction inference cost by ~30% and meet latency SLO in production.

Primary stakeholders
- Product: Ava Thompson (Owner)
- Engineering: Samir Rao (Tech lead)
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com
- Security/Compliance: TBD (you mentioned SOC2 report required)

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, dates)
1) Technical deep-dive + architecture alignment (internal SE + Acme eng) - Owner: Dev Patel (Redwood) / Samir - Target: 2027-04-25
2) POC week (test workload on Dedicated pool with sample traffic) - Owner: Dev Patel / Acme Eng - Target start: 2027-05-09, end: 2027-05-16
3) Pricing & commercial review (initial quote + potential reserved commit) - Owner: Marissa Cole / Acme Procurement - Target: 2027-05-02
4) Security/compliance exchange (SOC2, data handling, audit logs) - Owner: Priyom Das (Redwood Security) / Acme Security - Target: 2027-04-29
5) Exec decision and contract signature - Owner: Acme Execs / Marissa - Target: 2027-05-20

Decision process and timeline
- Technical approval from Samir and engineering team after POC week.
- Procurement needs formal quote and PO window; you mentioned a purchasing cycle that closes mid-May.
- If POC validates latency/cost, Acme plans an exec review week of 2027-05-17.

Attachments and links
- Attached: Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (basic milestones & owners)
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2027-004
- Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeMAP

Next steps (agreed on call)
- Marissa: send this MAP and pricing window (today) - done.
- Dev: schedule technical deep-dive for 4/25 (send invite + agenda) - action Dev.
- Samir/Ava: confirm SOC2 point-of-contact and procurement contact (if different) - action Acme.

Thanks - looking forward to this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
